mechanic_notes: Three routes: Sunbreak Coast, Redline Canyon, Halo Skyway.
Hybrid drive/fly with traffic, trailer roofs, facade banks, aerial tricks, and tuning upgrades.
limitations: Controls other than the menu click are declared by the plan/page copy, not runtime-verified (no fixed-input run; see R-25 part 2).
Page-evaluate stalls of up to ~75 s occur while the game loads under software GL; capture timeouts must allow for this.
No __getGameState hook is exposed; gameplay is evidenced by the DOM HUD text after the click.
root_cause_of_earlier_blocker: The earlier 'start click timed out / iframe lost' came from Prism sessions, not the game. On a software-GL runner the page's main thread is blocked for ~75 s while the game loads (one evaluate stalled 74867 ms; median 4 ms), so short-timeout clicks and evals fail. The probe's old matcher also only knew 'Start'/'Tap to start' labels and never saw 'Drive Sunbreak Coast'. Fixed in tools/crayon-probe (ranked start-control choice, real pointer click with long timeout, timed evaluates).
